## Non-Repetition Synthesis

Fresh derivation is required only where the owner deliberately delegated
bounded options: weighting/noise authority, quantitative approximation
conformance, covariance representation, immutable-state persistence,
response/product/interface persistence, and VAL profile granularity. The
author shall not reopen the approved estimand, ownership, parent, template,
support, unit/response, no-fallback, lifecycle, or FRUIT-separation decisions.
